covered.statement: The app shall send customers real-time push notifications for every account transaction, including amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
The app shall allow customers to instantly freeze and unfreeze their debit and credit cards without contacting the bank.
The app shall allow customers to set personalised monthly spending budgets per category and receive alerts when approaching or exceeding them.
The app shall support biometric authentication including fingerprint and face recognition as the primary login method.
The app shall allow customers to make instant peer-to-peer payments to other bank customers and to external accounts using account number or mobile number.
The app shall provide a unified view of all customer accounts including current, savings, and credit card balances on a single home screen.
The app shall allow customers to apply for overdraft increases, personal loans, and credit limit changes directly within the app.
The app shall process and display transaction notifications within five seconds of a transaction being authorised on the core banking system.
The app shall achieve a minimum App Store and Google Play rating of 4.2 within six months of launch, benchmarked against competitor fintech apps.
All new features must integrate with the existing core banking system via its current API layer without requiring mainframe modifications.
The app must comply with PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication requirements for all payment initiations and sensitive account access.
All customer financial data must be stored and processed within the European Economic Area in compliance with GDPR.
Any new credit or lending features must comply with Central Bank of Ireland consumer protection and responsible lending regulations.
The modernised app must maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for a minimum transition period of six months.

not_covered.statement: The app shall provide customers with automated monthly spending breakdowns categorised by merchant type such as groceries, dining, and transport.
The app shall provide in-app live chat and AI-assisted support for common customer queries without requiring a phone call.
The app shall be available 99.95% of the time, excluding scheduled maintenance windows communicated at least 48 hours in advance.
All sensitive customer data transmitted between the app and backend systems shall be encrypted using TLS 1.3 or higher.
The app shall be usable by customers with visual impairments, conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

requirement_coverage.interpretation: Partial — most areas addressed but some missed
